GTA Launch History: From 1997 Midnight Lines to GTA 6 (All 17 Releases)

post // Nov 25, 2026 · Updated Nov 26, 2026

Before Grand Theft Auto became the biggest entertainment launch in gaming, DMA Design pitched a top-down city game called Race-n-Chase. Three decades and 17 releases later, the way players show up on launch night has completely changed.

The Foundations (1997–2004)

From the original 1997 PC release and 1999's GTA 2 to the 3D explosion of GTA III (2001), Vice City (2002), and San Andreas (2004), each launch pushed consoles and retail stores harder than the one before it.

The Expansion & Midnight Line Era (2005–2013)

Handheld spin-offs, GTA IV's 2008 midnight lines, and GTA V's 2013 record-breaking debut (over 8,300 midnight store openings and GTA Online) turned release night into a worldwide retail event.

The Digital Shift (2026)

With GTA VI, the midnight line moved to the living room: digital preloads days before unlock and boxed editions shipping with a download code instead of a disc.

Which GTA launch do you remember most — waiting outside a store at midnight, or preloading from home?
